title: Error Recovery Map
description: Maps error types to deterministic recovery actions. LLM should use these exact solutions.

FileNotFoundError.description: Markdown file does not exist at specified path
recovery_steps: Search for file: find . -name '*.md' -type f | head -20

KeyError: 'type'.description: Missing type field in YAML frontmatter
recovery_steps: Add YAML frontmatter block at file start
KeyError: 'type'.example_fix:
---
type: analysis-report
title: My Analysis
date: 2025-01-09
---

ValidationError: Unknown type.description: Document type not in template registry

ValidationError: Missing sections.description: Required sections for template type not found
causes: Section names don't match template requirements
recovery_steps: Check template schema for required sections
Use H1 or H2 for section headers

WeasyPrintNativeLibError.description: WeasyPrint cannot load Pango/cairo/glib native libraries
recovery_steps: macOS: brew install pango cairo glib
macOS: render_pdf.py auto-sets DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/lib — re-run via 'uv run scripts/render_pdf.py ...'
Linux: apt install libpango-1.0-0 libpangoft2-1.0-0 libcairo2 libgdk-pixbuf2.0-0
WeasyPrintNativeLibError.example_fix: brew install pango cairo glib && uv run skills/markdown-to-pdf/scripts/render_pdf.py --self-test

PipelineMismatchError.description: Document type does not flow through the HTML render pipeline
causes: Doc type tagged 'pipeline: markdown-only' in its schema
Trying to /doc-to-pdf on meeting-notes, task-list, readme, or similar utility doc
recovery_steps: Check schema: cat templates/schemas/<type>.json | grep pipeline
Use /doc-to-pdf only on: analysis-report, literature-review, data-report
For other doc types, leave as markdown or use a different export tool
PipelineMismatchError.example_fix: Render pipeline only supports the three scientific doc types (see SKILL.md when_to_use)

recovery_steps: Check YAML syntax with online validator

common_fixes.missing_colon: title: My Title  # Needs colon after field name
common_fixes.special_chars: title: "Title: With Colon"  # Quote if contains :

recovery_steps: Convert to UTF-8: iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8 input.md > output.md
Open in editor and save as UTF-8

quick_reference.WeasyPrintNativeLibError: macOS: brew install pango cairo glib
quick_reference.PipelineMismatchError: Use /doc-to-pdf only on analysis-report / literature-review / data-report
